Screening records from Samsung Health Monitor
This app writes the heart rate and blood pressure data measured by your watch into the system’s Health Connect, so that apps such as Samsung Health can read and display it once syncing is enabled.
This data is stored only on your device and is never uploaded to any server. You can view and manage these permissions at any time in the system’s Health Connect settings.
